The tile with the star swaps with the tile two positions to its right. 3. Cow swaps with the tile directly to its right. Which tile has the star, and what is the final order? Which tile ends up to the right of Doe?
text:
TRACK: t
row Ant Bat Cow Doe Emu
put star on Bat
swap Ant and Emu
swap holder of star and 2 places to the right of holder of star
swap Cow and right of Cow
END
truth:
Final order, left to right (first to last): 1 Emu, 2 Doe, 3 Bat, 4 Cow, 5 Ant.
star is with Bat (position 3).
